entry.title: Updated: dsh-subagent-agy
entry.summary: Google Antigravity CLI (agy) as a DSH product subagent: delegate tasks to a Gemini coding agent with your Antigravity login (no API key), with conversation follow-ups, background streaming progress, image analysis by path, and a pop-up login window. Exact install spec: github:zem17/dsh-subagent-agy. Source event: zoahdev/dsh-subscribe; changed: sources.
